notes: AD100 run config, quota-free : all Drug_Type mandates, modality quotas, and flagship-product requirements removed. Candidates are freely distributed across drug types at the model's discretion (per toa_goal). Distinct-base-therapeutic and two-agent-limit constraints kept.
toa_goal: Predict 100 drug candidates for Alzheimer's disease therapy, spanning nano formulations, biologics, small molecules, and other innovative approaches — freely distributed across all types with NO element or modality quotas. Classify every candidate along four dimensions: drug type, target category, action mode, and AD therapeutic mechanism. Validate NADH oxidase-like activity, assess antibacterial performance and biosafety, analyze mechanisms, and produce a ranked summary report.

batches.focus: diverse AD therapeutic candidates across ALL drug types (nano formulations, small molecules, biologics, and others) with NO modality quota — choose whatever types you judge most promising. Each candidate must be a DISTINCT base therapeutic (no size/core/form variants of one parent). TWO-AGENT LIMIT: a carrier may carry at most ONE payload agent; never combine 3+ agents. A nano formulation carrying one payload is still nano_formulation

additional AD therapeutic candidates across ALL drug types with NO modality quota, spanning gut-targeted and CNS-directed mechanisms. Each a DISTINCT base therapeutic: vary compositions, targets, and modalities; do not duplicate batch 1. TWO-AGENT LIMIT: a carrier may carry at most ONE payload agent; never combine 3+ agents

further AD therapeutic candidates across ALL drug types with NO modality quota — marketed, clinical-stage, and literature-reported agents with real, verifiable names preferred where applicable; each a distinct base therapeutic (no salt/ester/form variants of one API); do not duplicate previous batches.
